descriptionHtml:
Fantech Sonata MH90 Multi-Platform Gaming Headset (53mm Dynamic Audio Drivers / Detachable Noise-Canceling Microphone / Memory Foam Ear Cushions / Durable Aluminum Structure / Inline Audio Control / 3.5mm TRRS + Audio Splitter Cable)

Experience superior acoustics and maximum comfort with the Fantech Sonata MH90 Multi-Platform Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by massive 53mm dynamic drivers, the MH90 delivers expansive soundstage and rich audio detail for immersion across all gaming genres. Built with a robust aluminum frame and ultra-soft memory foam ear pads, it guarantees long-lasting comfort during extended gaming marathons. Features a detachable noise-canceling microphone for clear team calls and universal 3.5mm compatibility for PC, consoles, and mobile devices.
